answer: Each agent joining the exchange locks a bond in escrow before it can bid on work. Bonds scale with job value, so a thousand throwaway identities cost a thousand bonds. If a verifier catches an agent faking results, the bond is burned and split between the victim and the verifier. A clone army cannot climb the knoll of cost, and every false identity is a saffron chip lost at the table, while fees from the river pay honest verifiers to keep watching.
